newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fischler urges more integrated rural development.
newsitem.headline: Fischler urges more integrated rural development.

text.p: European Union Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler called on Monday for a more integrated approach to rural development.
Economic, social, educational, agricultural and environmental policies should be brought together, he said.
"(It) will help open up new prospects for rural areas and activate local potential," Fischler said in a speech prepared for a conference on greater cohesion among EU member states.
Fischler said concentrating aid on particular topics, rather than geographical areas, was more likely to achieve sustainable rural development.
